title: Event sitemap entries carry a true lastmod from a new events.updated_at column

source.ref: Meta scan 2026-11-02, live sitemap parse: 372 of 588 URLs without lastmod, all 209 events among them

detail: events had no updated-at column, so SCAN-661 (which rightly stopped sending the future start date) left every event URL with no freshness signal. Migration 20270346028400 adds events.updated_at (backfilled from published_at or created_at, kept current by the shared set_updated_at trigger); the sitemap reader selects it and the sitemap emits it as lastModified, guarded so a future instant is still never sent. Expected lift: the largest URL group in the sitemap gets a true lastmod, so crawlers can prioritise changed events instead of recrawling all of them daily.

verify.evidence: Probe passes on this branch; migration applied to production and the live sitemap re-read.
